sentences.text:
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:47319
Court No. - 93
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 8120 of 2019

Applicant :- Ravi Srivastava And 2 Ors
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Swatantra Singh,Anita Singh,Dinesh Kumar Misra

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Sanjay Kumar Singh
Hon'ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal,J.
1.
List has been revised.

No one appeared on behalf of opposite party no.2.
2.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants and Sri Pushpendra Singh Jadaun, learned A.G.A. for the State.

3. The instant application has been moved on behalf of the applicants to quash the summoning order dated 29.01.2019 as well as proceedings of Complaint Case No.2648 of 2019 (Alka Srivastava Vs. Ravi Srivastava and others), under Section 498A IPC, Police Station Mehnajpur, District Azamgarh, pending before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No.12, Azamgarh.

entities.text: Complaint Case No.2648 of 2019 (Alka Srivastava Vs. Ravi Srivastava and others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No.12, Azamgarh
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for applicants submits that applicant no.1 and opposite party no.2 are husband and wife.
They have settled their dispute amicably and written compromise dated 04.12.2020 was also filed before the Additional Family Court First, Jaunpur.
In that compromise it was mentioned that opposite party no.2 after receiving Rs.7,10,000/- will agree for divorce and also withdraw the criminal cases including the impugned proceeding.

On the basis of that compromise, divorce decree Ravi Srivastava And 2 Ors vs State Of U.P. And Another on 15 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/90383144/
1 was also passed on 16.01.2021 by Additional Principal Judge, Family Court First, Jaunpur.

entities.text: Ravi Srivastava And 2 Ors vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
In this judgment, it is clearly mentioned that as per the compromise, opposite party no.2 had received Rs.7,00,000/- from applicant no.1.
5.

It is apparent from perusal of order dated 16.01.2021 passed by Additional Principal Judge,
Family Court First, Jaunpur that the compromise between the parties has been arrived at and on that basis payment of Rs.7,00,000/- has been made to the opposite party no.2 by applicant no.1 and on the basis of divorce decree dated 16.01.2021, both the parties are living separately.

entities.text:
Additional Principal Judge,
Family Court First, Jaunpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Therefore, it is explicit from the judgment and order dated 16.01.2021 of Additional Principal Judge, Family Court First, Jaunpur that the compromise deed dated 14.12.2020 was accepted by opposite party no.2.
6.

entities.text: Additional Principal Judge, Family Court First, Jaunpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
In view of the above, proceedings of Complaint Case No.2648 of 2019 (Alka Srivastava Vs. Ravi Srivastava and others), under Section 498A IPC, Police Station Mehnajpur, District Azamgarh,
pending before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No.12, Azamgarh, is hereby quashed.

entities.text: Complaint Case No.2648 of 2019 (Alka Srivastava Vs. Ravi Srivastava and others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No.12, Azamgarh
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 7. In view of the aforesaid observations, the present application is allowed.
